query: SELECT json_build_object('sim_appraisals',count(*),'sim_appraisal_rows_md5',md5(coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array(a.id,a.claim_id,a.appraiser_id,a.inspected_at,a.damage_amount_kurus,a.is_total_loss,a.notes,a.created_at) ORDER BY a.id)::text,'[]'))) FROM appraisals a JOIN claims c ON c.id=a.claim_id JOIN policies p ON p.id=c.policy_id WHERE p.policy_no LIKE 'SIM-%';
